### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

The Model Card Toolkit (MCT) streamlines and automates generation of [Model Cards](https://modelcards.withgoogle.com/about) [1], machine learning documents that provide context and transparency into a model's development and performance. Integrating the MCT into your ML pipeline enables you to share model metadata and metrics with researchers, developers, reporters, and more.
